title: Scheduler
description: Cron schedules for agent threads. Every scheduler.cron trigger instance is bound to a thread and fires it when its cron expression is due, evaluated in the organization timezone. Missed runs follow the selected policy: catch up within an hour, skip, or skip and open an approval inbox item.

descriptor.title: Cron schedule
descriptor.description: Run an agent on a cron schedule

options.label: Catch up
options.help: Runs missed while the host was asleep still fire within the next hour.

options.label: Skip
options.help: Missed runs are dropped; the next scheduled run fires as usual.

options.label: Skip and ask
options.help: Missed runs are dropped and an approval inbox item asks what to do.

sections.body: Every schedule is a trigger instance bound to a thread. The planner ticks every minute, fires due schedules with run-level deduplication, and applies the missed-run policy: catch-up fires runs missed within the last hour, skip drops them, escalate drops them and opens an approval inbox item. An invalid cron expression or a thread that cannot run marks the schedule as failed.
